title: Add partial refunds to the payments API
detail: Support partial refunds initiated by support agents, keep settlement statistics correct, and expose the operation through the existing payments API.

title: Plan: refund flow, schema, settlement reconciliation
detail: 1) Add refund method on PaymentService. 2) Add refunds and refund_stats tables. 3) Recompute settlement totals in the same batch run. 4) Update OpenAPI and docs. 5) Extend tests.

title: Settlement batch made atomic
detail: Wrapped the ledger writes in repository.withTransaction so a mid-batch failure cannot leave the ledger ahead of the payments table.

title: Rejected: pessimistic lock on payment rows
detail: Considered SELECT ... FOR UPDATE around the refund read and write. Rejected to avoid holding row locks while the audit log append runs, which is a filesystem call.

title: No new runtime dependencies
detail: The service must keep its production dependency set unchanged for this release; Node built-ins only.

title: Ran unit suite (partial)
detail: Executed `npm test -- paymentService` and `tsc --noEmit` in the repository. The full suite was not run because the database container was unavailable.

title: Typecheck passed; database tests not executed
detail: tsc --noEmit exited 0 after the refund changes. Tests that require PostgreSQL were skipped; no concurrency test was run against the refund path.

title: Per-merchant refund limit is documented but not enforced
detail: docs/payments.md states the limit is enforced before funds are released; the implementation leaves a TODO and does not call loadRefundPolicy.
